metadata.title: Elon Musk Staked His Empire on Texas. Now State Democrats Want to Rein Him In. - WSJ

content.text:
Elon Musk made a $225 million bet on Texas. Now, a new wave of Democratic leaders has the power to stall his projects.
Musk-run companies like SpaceX SPCX 8.62%increase; up pointing triangle and Tesla TSLA 4.23%increase; up pointing triangle have flourished in the state thanks to white-glove treatment from elected officials—mainly Republicans—including tax incentives, infrastructure benefits, and legislation that makes it difficult to sue his companies. That is about to change, Texas Democrats who spoke to The Wall Street Journal said.
